page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-192-metal is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server. It features 192 vCPUs across 96 physical Intel Xeon 8481C cores running at 4.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 768 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This bare-metal instance does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results show top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores ranking in the top 10%. The Intel Xeon processors support advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 13,143.3 GB/sec and uncached large block reads at 466.69 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench text processing scoring in the average and bottom 25% tiers respectively.

Given its bare-metal architecture and high resource density, this server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require direct hardware access without hypervisor overhead. It is highly suited for high-throughput database operations, Redis deployments, and static web serving, all of which achieved top-tier benchmark results. Additionally, the inclusion of AMX instructions enables strong performance in CPU-based LLM inference and software compilation tasks.
